The issuer exhibits a solid financial profile characterized by strong liquidity (current ratio of 3.37x) and moderate leverage, with total liabilities representing approximately 48% of total assets. Profitability is respectable, as demonstrated by a 14% operating margin and $380M in net income on $5,209M of revenue. These credit metrics, alongside a substantial equity base of over $5B, reflect an investment-grade risk profile typical of a stable, upper-medium-grade borrower.

DECISION: A-
